rule.name: UAM_generateEmailBodyForReject
rule.description: To generate the email body for Reject
rule.definition:
a!localVariables( local!teamDetails: #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1132811"(TeamId: ri!teamid), local!teamNames: joinarray( index( local!teamDetails, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:bb51e73c-01e7-4e73-8a7b-4187491dde54/d4a08ef8-b6c6-4db9-bb25-3be3a8bcbf2a", {} ), ", " ), local!orgDetails: #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1123673"(orgId: ri!orgid), local!orgName: index( local!orgDetails, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:008dc9c2-5821-421b-b1dd-e322b8e6665f/0f073a93-5255-4fd3-bdba-87d2febf50e9", "–" ), local!teamroles: #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1138645"(teamid: ri!teamid, isActive: true()), local!teamgroupids: index( local!teamroles, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:139cb21e-dd78-4694-a8ad-b43e2d51226f/da39fffc-c223-49f0-b99c-5a3a8f8ad3b8", {} ), local!groupdetails: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!teamgroupids), #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1136584"(groupid: local!teamgroupids), {} ), local!groupnames: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!groupdetails), index( local!groupdetails, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:c4386edd-8146-4849-a78b-d8ad760265af/e8ca0cac-e7b4-4dfc-a87f-9c9f6e12a24c", {} ), {} ), /* Format group names as HTML list */ local!groupNamesHtmlList: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!groupnames), "
    " & joinarray( #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!groupnames, expression: "
  • " & fv!item & "
    • " ), "" ) & "
", "No roles requested" ), local!userName: tostring(ri!username), " Team Access Request Rejected

Dear " & local!userName & ",

This email is to notify you that your Team Access Request has been Rejected.

Organization: " & local!orgName & "
Team Name: " & local!teamNames & "
Requested Roles: " & local!groupNamesHtmlList & "

Please contact your administrator if you have any questions.


This is a system generated mail.

" )
